title: TurnStart
description: turn: the server starts a turn the node did not ask for; her answer follows in frames that refer to its id.

cause.description: Why: first_boot (she wakes up for the very first time), connected (the user is back), looking_glass_entered and looking_glass_exited (the node shows her on a Looking Glass now, or no longer: display, since 1.4). part_switched (the user switched a part of her body on the node: part, since 1.5). server_restarted (the server was down and is back: she is told how long, since 1.5). task_ended (a task of hers, a web search or a page she asked for, ended and she is told what it found, since 1.6). Unknown causes are played as a plain turn.
